decisions.quote: Thus, the ordering effect reported in Wang and Voss (2015) was identified in this larger, combined sample.
decisions.reason: No prior adjudication or state files exist for this request. The full text explicitly distinguishes and empirically retests two separately published findings: (1) the immediate post-regimen paired-associate learning improvement reported in Wang et al. (2014, Science, 10.1126/science.1252900), which is present as shipped row 122, and (2) the multi-week persistence/carry-over ordering effect across the 2-week between-week washout period (comparing Week 2 baseline Pre-Sham performance in the stimulation-first group against Pre-Stim performance in the sham-first group) separately published in Wang and Voss (2015, Hippocampus, 25(8), 877-883, 10.1002/hipo.22416). Although Wang and Voss (2015) analyzed order subgroups from the original crossover experiment, that long-lasting persistence/ordering finding was published in the separate 2015 Hippocampus article rather than the 2014 Science paper, and the current replication explicitly retests and confirms it in Results section 3.1 and Discussion section 4. Note that Luna's identity_quote failed mechanical validation due to line breaks around the author names in the reference list; an intact literal quote from Results section 3.1 is supplied here.
